# SCC SYSTEM CONTEXT
## SYSTEM ATLAS
# SYSTEM PURPOSE
ARCHETYPE: infrastructure_project
[SYSTEM PURPOSE — from README, DOCUMENTATION not fact]
This application serves normalized radio transcripts over HTTP. The API layer routes requests, and the service layer owns the transcript repository and its database. Raw transcripts are immutable once stored.

Golden repository for SCC tests: HTTP -> service -> database flow.
